review: Only host success comparison and supplementary fingerprint changed. libc memcmp scans the complete allocated output/source extent. A nonzero result enters original exhaustive exact-byte-offset comparison with original1024 failure budget; mismatch is never PASS. Hash uses safe memcpy uint64 chunks plus byte tail, named native-endian word FNV-style (not standard byte FNV-1a and not SHA); not the equality oracle. This removes serial per-byte hashing/branch overhead from hundreds of GiB of diagnostic readback. All input construction, old/group kernel calls, guard extents/refusal matrices, queue dependencies/checked drains/free and smoke/small/full fixed coverage/counts remain unchanged. SHA256 artifact identities still independent.
fingerprint_algorithm: native-endian uint64-word FNV-style; noncryptographic supplementary identity only
full_byte_oracle: memcmp entire extents; exhaustive byte scan on any mismatch
